characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Coordinated Assault: This Turn, you resolve the top three cards of your Command Stack as
one 'go'. Draw three cards, resolving the Actions for each in Turn before your opponent draws
their next Command Card. (These Activation Cards cannot draw other Activation Cards from
your Command Stack. If their rules include such wording, ignore the rule.)

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Legacies of the Ark: If the Lineage Highborne is your Warlord, it may select any number
of Mutations, instead of the one normally allowed. It pays full points for these extra choices.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Suppress Survival Instinct: All your Regiments gain +2 Resolve for the remainder of this Turn.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Enemy Regiments in contact with the Character's Regiment have the Decay (3) Draw Event (Decay 2 if it is a Brute Regiment, Decay 1 if it is a Monster Regiment).

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per game, the Character Stand gains the following Draw Event in addition to any other: Choose a friendly Regiment within 6”. That Regiment may immediately perform a free Clash, Volley or March Action.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Character has the Biotic Renewal Draw Event.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Whenever the Character's Regiment processes a Decay Draw Event of any kind, all enemy Regiments in base contact also possess the Decay (4) Draw Event (Decay 3 if it is a Brute Regiment, Decay 2 if it is a Monster Regiment).

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Character Stand and any Regiment it has joined reduce all Decay Draw Events inflicted upon them by -1 (e.g. Decay 3 becomes Decay 2).

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Once per game, when this Character is slain, roll a D6. On a score of 4+, you may remove another friendly Character Stand from the Battlefield, and return this Character Stand to the Battlefield in its place with as many wounds as the character being removed had. If this Character is your Warlord, they are not considered to be Slain for Scenario and Objective purposes.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Character Stand may Re-roll 1 die every time they are required to make an Injury roll.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Whenever this Character's Command Card is drawn from the Command Stack, roll a D6. On a score of 4+ or more, you may increase its Clash, Volley, Resolve or Defence by +1 (to a maximum of 5).

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Evasion Rolls cannot be taken against Hits caused by this Character.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Whenever a Wound is allocated to the Character, roll a D6. On a score of 3 or less, an enemy Regiment or Character Stand of your choice within 6" also has a Wound allocated to it. On a roll of 1, all enemy Regiments and Character Stands within 6” suffer this effect.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Character has the Barrage 4 (20", Deadly Shot) special rule.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Character Stand gains the Barrage (2) (30”, Armor Piercing 1) Special Rule. If the Character Stand already has the Barrage Special Rule then its Barrage value is increased by 2. Furthermore, it’s Armor Piercing value increases +1.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Character has the Deadly Blades and Deadly Shots special rule.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When this Character takes an Action, you may have it gain +2 Clash and +4 Attacks. If you do, remove the Character Stand as a casualty once the Action is complete.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: A Character with this Mutation changes his Troop Type to Brute and may no longer purchase a Retinue. The character can thus legally join Brute Units and can gain access to new rules such as Impact Hits, etc.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: When this Character's Command Card is drawn, you may both look at the top Command Card of your opponent’s Command Stack and draw and act with your next Command Card instead of this Character’s Command Card. If you do, place the Character's Command Card on top of the Command Stack once the Action is resolved. Return your opponent’s Command Card to their Command Stack. This Ability can only be activated once every Round.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: The Character ignores the first Wound allocated to it in a Duel each turn.

- All friendly Infantry Stands have +1 Attack and gain the Decay 3 Draw Event.
- All friendly Cavalry and Brute Stands have +2 Attacks and gain the Decay 4 Draw Event.
- All friendly Monster Stands have +4 Attacks and gain Decay 6 Draw Event.

one 'go'. Draw three cards, resolving the Actions for each in Turn before your opponent draws
their next Command Card. (These Activation Cards cannot draw other Activation Cards from
your Command Stack. If their rules include such wording, ignore the rule.)

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text:
Legacies of the Ark: If the Lineage Highborne is your Warlord, it may select any number
of Mutations, instead of the one normally allowed. It pays full points for these extra choices.

characteristics.name: Description
characteristics.$text: Suppress Survival Instinct: All your Regiments gain +2 Resolve for the remainder of this Turn.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Draw your next Command Card. You may place it on the bottom of the Command Stack. If you do, that Regiment Heals D6 Wounds. The Character then takes its Action.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text:
Choose one: The Pheromancer's Regiment has the Fluid Formation special rule until the end of the Turn.
OR
The Regiment has +2 March until the end of the Turn. The Character then takes its Action.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Look at your next three Command Cards. Choose one, and place it on the bottom of your Command Stack. Place the others on top of the Command Stack in any order. Draw your next Command Card. That Regiment acts immediately, but has the Decay (4) Draw Event until the end of the Turn. The Character then takes its Action.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Draw your next Command Card. That Regiment acts immediately and may take two Actions of the same type this Turn, but also has the Decay 3 (Decay 4 if it is a Brute Regiment, Decay 6 if it is a Monster Regiment) Draw Event until the end of the Turn. The Character then takes its Action

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Draw your next Command Card. You may place that card at the bottom of the Command Stack. If you do, all Stands in the Pheromancer’s Regiment gain +1 Clash until the end of the Turn. Then, draw your next Command Card. You may place that card at the bottom of the Command Stack. If you do, all Stands in the Pheromancer's Regiment gain +1 Evasion until end of the Turn. If at any point you elect not to place a Command Card at the bottom of the Command Stack, but instead place it back on top of the Command Stack, then the Draw Event has no further effect

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Draw your next Command Card. If you wish, you may have that Regiment suffer D6 Wounds. If you do, all enemy Regiments in contact with that Regiment also suffer D6 Wounds. That Regiment then acts. The Character then takes its Action.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Target one friendly Regiment within 18". That Regiment suffers 2D6 Wounds. Draw your next Command Card. If that Regiment is of the same type, it regains 2D6 Wounds. Then, activate the Regiment whose Command Card you just drew. The Character then takes its Action.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Draw your next Command Card. That Regiment has the Deadly Blades or Deadly Shot special rules until the end of the Turn. That Regiment then acts. The Character then takes its Action.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Draw your next Command Card. That Regiment acts. For each Wound it inflicts with a Clash, or with Impact Hits, roll a D6. On a score of 4 or more, the Regiment regains a Wound. The Character then takes its Action.

characteristics.name: Effect
characteristics.$text: Draw your next Command Card. Until the end of the Turn, all Stands in that Regiment have +4 March, +2 Clash and +1 Volley. The Regiment then acts but has the Decay 3 (Decay 4 if it is a Brute Regiment , Decay 6 if it is a Monster Regiment ) Draw Event.

rules.name: Cautious Casting
rules.description: Once per game, the Character may re-roll all dice for a single Spellcasting Roll.

rules.name: Focused
rules.description: The Character may reroll 1 die during any Spellcasting Action.

sharedSelectionEntries.name: Arcane Mastery: Learned in the Occult

rules.name: Learned in the Occult
rules.description: The Character may purchase one extra spell from a dierent School.

rules.name: Magus
rules.description: The Character increases any non-scaling spell diculty value by 1.

rules.name: Wizened Caster
rules.description: The character gains the benefits of 1st Rank Tactical Retinue.

rules.name: Pheromonic Node: Leader
rules.description: A Regiment with a Leader halves (rounding up) the number of Wounds it suers when making a Fighting Reform (page 166) or a Fighting Withdrawal (page 169). In addition, the presence of a Leader allows the Regiment to re-roll a single failed hit roll during Volley or Clash Actions.

rules.name: Pheromonic Node: Standard Bearer
rules.description: A Regiment with a Standard Bearer may re-roll failed Charges, and adds one to its March distance (not the March characteristic) on the second March Action it performs in one activation.

rules.name: Assault Preceptor
rules.description: While the Assault Preceptor is alive, the Regiment has the Fury Draw Event

rules.name: Catabolic Node
rules.description: The first time the Regiment uses a Clash Action, roll 2D6. The Bio Bomb inflicts that number of hits on one enemy Regiment in contact with its Regiment. It also inflicts a number of hits on its own Regiment equal to the highest score of the individual D6s rolled. Hits are always treated as if they have been inflicted from the front. Then remove the Catabolic Node model as a casualty and replace it with a spare Rank and File model.

rules.name: Ward Preceptor
rules.description: While the Ward Preceptor is alive, the Regiment has the Bastion Draw Event.

rules.name: Attracting Pheromones
rules.description: The Character and any Regiment they have joined gains the Spearhead Special Rule.

rules.name: Elder
rules.description: The Character may purchase two additional Mutations.

rules.name: Combat Mastery: Eagle Eye
rules.description: The Character may re-roll natural rolls of 6 when taking part in a Volley Action.

rules.name: Fleshcarver
rules.description: When a friendly Regiment receives any healing effects caused by this character, they heal 1 extra wound.

rules.name: Plaguelord
rules.description: Whenever an enemy Model is removed as a casualty by Decay effects caused by this Character or the Regiment they have joined, another wound is dealt to the enemy regiment (no saves allowed).

sharedSelectionEntryGroups.name: Mutations (Lineage Highborne)
sharedSelectionEntryGroups.comment: This list applies if Lineage Highborne's Supremacy Ability is active

rules.name: Mastery of Flesh Tier 1
rules.description: The Character may as an Action Choose a friendly Character within 12” and roll 1 die. On an 1-2 heal 2 wounds from that Character, otherwise heal 1 wound instead.

rules.name: Mastery of Flesh Tier 3
rules.description: May take an Additional Pheromancy/Biomancy. The Character may activate an additional Draw Event per turn.
